title: Fireboy & Watergirl Zombie (ze_fireboy_watergirl)
description:
Fireboy & Watergirl

It is a map that works with cs2 zombie escape mode inspired by the most enjoyable game of our childhood.

This map was made for the “Return to Roots - Mapping Contest” event. For information about the event: 

ze_fireboy_watergirl

The map consists of 2 levels.

1.lvl - Nostalgia

This level contains the original 3 chapters of the game.

2.lvl - Modern

This level is designed to adapt the original game to zombie mode.

Items

Fire : Burns zombies.
Water : Slows down zombies.
